lines.en: I favour one leg and move sideways.

lines.zh: 我的脖子上有一圈咬痕。
lines.en: A ring of bite marks circles my neck.
I wade through standing water.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地拖着右脚。
lines.en: I drag my right foot, step by step.

lines.zh: 我绕过一具倒在路边的尸体。
lines.en: I go around a body by the roadside.
My head stays low.

lines.zh: 我从雨里走出来，浑身湿透。
lines.en: I come out of the rain, soaked through.

lines.zh: 我沿着楼与楼之间的缝走。
lines.en: I take the gap between buildings.
My shoulder scrapes the wall.
I stop every few steps.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地朝热闹的地方挪。
lines.en: I shuffle toward the noise.
Water gathers in my footprints.
I crouch in the rain, face turned up.
Rain thins the blood on me.
I gnaw the back of my own hand.
My eyelids are only half raised.

lines.zh: 我在听雨打铁皮的声音。
lines.en: I listen to rain on sheet metal.
My breath is watery.
I press my back to the cold wall.
I wait for the rain to stop.
I'm counting my own joints.
I stay still, like so much junk.
You're dry.
I tilt my face up slowly.
Your blood is racing. I hear it.
Mud on your soles — you've run far.
You're much cleaner than I.

lines.zh: 我朝你伸出手，水往下滴。
lines.en: I reach for you, water dripping.
Don't stand by the wall; I'm here.
I still have my teeth.
Step back, and I'll follow slowly.

lines.zh: 这雨里只有你一个活人。
lines.en: You're the only living one in this rain.
I slip in the water.
I step back and lean on the wall.
The rain has opened my wound again.
I make a wet sound.
That left me limping worse.
I drop to my knees in the water.
My fingers close on water.
I look up at you and blink slowly.
Your blows fall heavier than the rain.
My leg is broken; I crawl on my hands.

lines.zh: 那点热气在雨里很明显。
lines.en: That warmth is obvious in the rain.

lines.zh: 你把手里的东西放下了。
lines.en: You've set down what you held.
I drag my feet over.
Rain doesn't wash that smell away.
I lower my head to sniff.
I wait for you to let go yourself.
Three more steps and I bite.
That blood smell is thick.
My jaw trembles once.
I bend slowly.
Bump into me — that's close enough to bite.
My good leg gives slightly.
I shoulder you aside.
Don't push — this leg is crooked.
We collide and I lurch.
Your sole is on my foot.
I press to the wall to let you pass.
That left me wet and colder.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子，没用力。
lines.en: I catch your sleeve without force.
I step back, still dripping.
Another sways over through the rain.

lines.zh: 它也少了一条腿的力气。
lines.en: It's short a leg's strength too.
Our foreheads touch.
We crouch under the eaves together.

lines.zh: 它身上的水淌到我这里。
lines.en: Its water runs onto me.

lines.zh: 我们的呼吸合成一片水声。
lines.en: Our breathing becomes one watery sound.
It faces east; so do I.
Two wet shadows lean together.
Two of us in this alley now.
Even in rain there's company.
I crouch with a hand in the water.
I snatch up a wet rag.
I take it in my teeth.
It slid out of my hand.
I fish in the standing water again.
This has been softened by water.
I stuff it into a pocket.
This one is mine now.

lines.zh: 这条腿，我拖回去慢慢吃。
lines.en: I'll drag this leg home to eat.
I drop it into the water.
You're still upright. Good.
I straighten my back slowly.
The rain has washed my scent away.
I shuffle your way.
All my teeth are showing.
You've backed past the puddle.
I bear down on you step by step.
This alley has no way out.

lines.zh: 我记着你缩在哪个角落。
lines.en: I've noted which corner you're in.
The rain will cover my steps.
Three more steps.
Do you hear the water?
My neck crackles.
I won't wait any longer.
The living are warmer than the dead.
I follow along the wall's base.
The rain swallows all sound.
Wherever you walk, water splashes.
I'm at the other end of the puddle.
I close the distance slowly.
You're soaked; you can't run well.
I count the puddles you've crossed.
I move under the tin eaves.

lines.zh: 你的后背湿了一片，很好。
lines.en: Your back is soaked. Good.
I wait under the eaves.
One step closer.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在雨里也很清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing is clear even in the rain.
I settle my body lower.
There's a wall ahead.
The rain won't help you.
I'm behind you already.
Only the two of us here.
I raise my hands.
I bite your wrist.
I shoulder into your chest.
It's wet, and cold.
You throw me off; I step back.
I hold your coat and don't let go.
We fall into the standing water together.
Water splashes high.
I press your shoulder down.
You're under me on the wet ground.
My teeth are blunt, but I don't let go.
Blood washes away in the rain.
You struggle once more.

lines.zh: 我仰起脸，雨水顺着下巴流。
lines.en: I lift my face, rain running off my chin.
You still have strength to struggle. Rare.
That tore the cloth open.
I had my teeth in and didn't let go.

lines.zh: 雨里多了一个站着的人影。
lines.en: A standing shape joins the rain.

lines.zh: 我从水里慢慢地站起来。
lines.en: I rise slowly out of the water.
Water sounds under the eaves.

lines.zh: 这里多了个跛脚的东西。
lines.en: Something lame has come here.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了一个水洼里的倒影。
lines.en: I break a reflection in a puddle.
I show through the curtain of rain.
Rain runs between my fingers.

lines.zh: 雨水顺着我的脸往下淌。
lines.en: Rain runs down my face.
I straighten my spine slowly.
I stop in the middle of the puddle.
I come to a stop under a window.

lines.zh: 巷子里的雨忽然更冷了。
lines.en: The rain in the alley turns colder.
I lift my face, mouth open.
The streetlight finds me.

lines.zh: 火燎着我的湿衣服，冒起白气。
lines.en: Fire hits my wet clothes and steam rises.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，摔在水里。
lines.en: I tumble down the steps into the water.

lines.zh: 水已经在我肺里了，又灌进来。
lines.en: There's water in my lungs already, and more comes.
The blast throws me into the puddle.

lines.zh: 一枚东西打穿了我的肩。
lines.en: Something punches through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 法术让我的皮一阵发麻。
lines.en: That spell crawls over my skin.

lines.zh: 我饿得连腿都抬不起来。
lines.en: Too hungry to lift my leg.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，水让我麻得更透。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and the water spreads the numbness.

lines.zh: 虚空把我从水里拽出去。
lines.en: The void pulls me out of the water.
